account: Measured subtotal of unique retained Codex response-ID usage records; incomplete project coverage

coverage.included: 54 retained project-directory root sessions and eight isolated scientific implementation-comparison sessions with actual response-ID usage. Includes recorded review, coordination, failed attempts and context-compaction work in those sessions.
coverage.missing: All 142 inventoried child-agent exports lack response-ID records and are outside this subtotal. Overall, 232 exports have counters only and one has no usage metadata. Unexported/other-client work and activity after the cutoff are also outside the snapshot. Unknown usage is not zero.
coverage.excluded: Other-workspace Codex exports. Counter totals and retained comparison-report totals are not added to response totals.

method.deduction: Deduplicate by response_id globally; equal IDs must have identical usage and model. Sum usage fields once per response.
method.subsets: Total equals input plus output. Cached input is inside input; reasoning output is inside output. Neither subset is added again.
method.counter_policy: Verify first thread snapshot and every increment against unique response usage. Counters are not summands; 232 counter-only exports stay outside this subtotal.
method.evidence_limit: Token volume measures development activity and supplies no scientific qualification or correctness evidence.
method.model_label_limit: Model labels come from turn_context.model. The response-usage record has no model field; special compaction/routing model differences are not separately verified.
method.ui_counter_policy: token_count UI counters are not summed. Explicit compaction markers explain some differences; remaining UI decreases/scope differences are retained in the private audit. Actual response IDs and all 62 thread_token_usage snapshots agree exactly.

historical_account_reconciliation.account: Retained finite-response-law preparation-screen implementation comparisons; four underlying response sets overlap the published comparison reports.

privacy: Raw chats, prompts, reasoning text, session/response IDs and private source paths are not included.
